display_title: Aren't We Supposed to Hold Hands First?
description:
Park Chun-Jae, a 20-year-old gay man who moved to the city with big dreams of finding a lover. The first thing he did upon arriving in Seoul was install a popular dating app! He went to an amusement park, went on dates at famous restaurants... With these happy fantasies, he went on his first date with a man named 'KAZ' whom he met on a dating app. "Are you sure your nickname is 'Gomdollatte'?" He was surprised by his fair skin, pretty face, and much smaller body. But where did KAZ take him often? A hotel?! 

*"Uh, we just met..." 

"Huh? Isn't this why we met? It's okay. I won't get sick."*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes 4 side story chapters.*
